newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.23 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.23 pct lower.

text.p: Tunis stock exchange on Friday closed down by 0.23 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.74 points, down from 447.81 on Thursday.
Airline Tunis Air fell 3.72 dinars to 19.72 dinars with only 358 shares changing hands. Insurance firm ASTREE was down 0.7 dinar to 22.96 dinars.
Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie eased 0.23 dinar to 7.67 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat declined 0.1 dinar to 15.68 dinars.
Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis was up 1.98 dinar to 78 dinars.
Total volume was 374,957 dinars against 3.73 million dinars over the previous session.
